label: PHASE12_ORACLE_FREE_BASELINES_R2
scope: SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim; oracle only SELECT+GRAPH control; all methods use oracle for post-hoc safety evaluation.
run_order: index ascending, methods in protocol order; serial; no retries
executor: unchanged PP lookahead .25; CURV target clip(.4/abs(kappa),.05,.3), |dv/dt|<=.5, omega clip(v*kappa,+/-.4); original endpoint and timeout stops

hermite.tangent: B yaw; outgoing segment tangent at J, last incoming at endpoint; both magnitudes Euclidean |J-B|
hermite.degenerate: J=B or invalid native path: invalid path stop until next valid chunk; never choose a different join
hermite.continuity: analytic cubic C1 at boundaries; executed samples approximate it, no exact sampled secant-heading claim

temporal.label: ACT temporal ensembling (spatial adaptation)
temporal.validity: each own controller receive/release monotonic timestamp; age<1s; at most last3 valid XY chunks
temporal.progress: independent unchanged PP monotonic progress per chunk
temporal.endpoint: stop iff all live component followers endpoint-stop; no live path or latest waypoint timeout => stop
temporal.clamp: control tick clamped if any live component clamps; weighted fraction also logged
temporal.mechanisms: ensemble has no single path: Phase6 per-component projection cross-track weighted mean; heading absolute error weighted mean only if all component tangents valid (20mm); latest native path only labeled diagnostic, never misreported as averaged path

bid.label: BID backward-coherence only
bid.score: mean Euclidean position difference at 1cm arclength offsets including0 and common endpoint; project independently from B
bid.eligible: current OLD received <1s ago; per-candidate common length>=2cm; invalid paths excluded
bid.fallback: sample0 if no eligible candidate/no valid OLD; lower index exact ties; no forward contrast

technical_gate.action: TECHNICAL_FAILURE disables only that new method for indices26–34; no retry; other methods continue

decisions.BEATS: FRESHEST+GRAPH-GF successes >= comparator +3; otherwise FAIL; invalid methods INCONCLUSIVE
decisions.SPEED: both successful pairs>=5 and each method>=9 valid: mean speed difference; 20,000 paired bootstrap replicates seed20261026; lower>0 FASTER, upper<0 SLOWER, otherwise NOT_SHOWN
decisions.oracle_gap: SELECT+GRAPH minus FRESHEST+GRAPH-GF: successes and both-success paired mean speed; descriptive only

offline.selection: First eligible chronological actual SELECT+GRAPH handoffs, round-robin across index17–24; no filtering on solver success or navigation outcome. Earlier three-kernel30-case check retained separately.
offline.graph_comparison: Same recorded B/previous actual command/eight samples; FRESHEST chosen without safety; previous accepted Phase8 path reused as OLD path (privileged provenance, no geometry input). One GF solve/case, compare recorded Phase8 result. Offline solver acceptance differs from online stale/superseded.

fairness: Main methods1–6 use only RGB + Topomap for NoMaD, actual robot state, OLD/FRESH chunks and eight samples.
Obstacle and wall coordinates are never used by main-method control; identical oracle geometry is used only for collision/corridor evaluation.
SELECT+GRAPH alone uses oracle control and is a privileged reference, excluded from main decisions.
All methods share executor, delay, seed and timeout; computation latency is real and outputs are applied only after completion.

graph_gf.selection: longest remaining sample after B nearest projection, no safety filter; ties lower index; all invalid -> sample0 invalid-path stop
graph_gf.graph: FlagGraphV4 subclass; inherited numerical residual and SLSQP, original weights unchanged; no scene config or field parameters
graph_gf.side_labels: empty: impossible to derive obstacle sides without forbidden geometry
graph_gf.acceptance: solver converged AND retained constraints satisfied; no obstacle/corridor certificate
graph_gf.online: unchanged Phase8 immediate selected path, every switched FRESH submitted FIFO, next eligible tick, SUPERSEDED, >0.5s STALE, waypoint timeout1s, fallback CURV
graph_gf.assertions: strict numeric selector shapes; worker allowlist; protocol exact unchanged constants plus fixed flags
